verdict_reason: Branch tab cases are removed correctly, but a one-element loop is left behind and the rewritten Importer search test keeps an option-label name it no longer tests.

todos.issue: With the Branch entry removed, 'lists the default seed address on the Origin and Consignor tab only' (list.fit.spec.js:398-409) still loops 'for (const addressType of [ADDRESS_TYPES.DESTINATION_CONSIGNEE_OR_IMPORTER])' over a one-element array, a shape that reads as if more tabs were still checked.
todos.fix: Must: the test opens the Destination tab once with no loop. One way: replace the for loop with a single openAddressBookList call for ADDRESS_TYPES.DESTINATION_CONSIGNEE_OR_IMPORTER followed by the NO_RESULTS_LINE assertion.

todos.issue: The rewritten test 'finds an address holding the Importer role by searching the Destination tab for importer' (list.fit.spec.js:794-811) keeps the organisation prefix 'stub-org-list-importer-option-label' (:798). The Branch version proved a search matched the Type option label ('Branch Address') where the column label ('Branch') did not; Importer's option and column labels are both 'Importer' (copy.en.js:63), so the prefix names option-label matching the test no longer exercises, and the test now proves what 'finds an address by the label of one of its roles' (:772) already proves.
todos.fix: Must: no fit test or seed name claims option-label matching it does not exercise, and the Importer search test proves something :772 does not, or is gone. One way: delete the test, or keep it with a prefix such as 'stub-org-list-importer-role-search' if the Destination-tab Type cell assertion is worth its own test.
